provinces.lore: Deep inland forest between Mộc Lan and Liên Giang. Its people dig wild ginseng and sell it to Băng Tâm's alchemists. A Wood vein lies among old roots.

places.name: Cổ Căn Huyệt
places.look: A hollow under a fallen giant tree, its roots arching overhead.
places.lore: A Wood vein rises among the roots of the fallen tree. The best wild ginseng of the frost coast grows around it, and Tàng Sâm's diggers say a root from here is worth a year of ordinary digging.

places.name: Tàng Sâm Thôn
places.look: Log houses deep in the forest, with ginseng roots drying on trays.
places.lore: The villagers dig wild ginseng and sell it to Băng Tâm's alchemists. They never tell outsiders where it grows.

provinces.name: Thiết Chùy
provinces.lore: Forest and mountains on the south-west coast around Băng Lăng Khoáng. Its people mine and work the cold metal for Băng Tâm. A peak hung with icicles stands over the village.

places.name: Băng Lăng Khoáng
places.look: A mine mouth high on a bare grey mountainside, a timber headframe and spoil heaps under snow. Over the adit hangs a curtain of icicles thick as a man, which the miners walk through and never break.

places.name: Thùy Lăng Phong
places.look: A peak above the village, its cliffs hung with long icicles.
places.lore: Its Water and Metal qi feed the cold of Băng Lăng Khoáng below. The icicles never fall, even in summer, and the miners of Thiết Chùy touch the nearest one for luck before going underground.

places.name: Thiết Chùy Thôn
places.look: Stone houses on the coast, ringing with the sound of hammers.
places.lore: The villagers mine and work the cold metal of Băng Lăng Khoáng. They wrap their boots in felt underground.

provinces.name: Thanh Lăng Lĩnh
provinces.lore: Mountains and forest inland of the frost coast. No one lives here. Azurite is mined in summer.

places.name: Không Thanh Khoáng
places.look: A small mine in a fold of the forested mountain, its spoil heaps streaked bright blue against the snow.
places.lore: Azurite is dug here in summer and ground into the blue pigment called stone blue. Băng Tâm paints the ceilings of its ice halls with it, and the miners' hands stay blue until midwinter.

places.name: Hàn Nha Phong
places.look: A bare grey peak stands above the forest, its ledges black with roosting crows at dusk.
places.lore: Its Metal qi gathers in the bare rock. Crows roost on it in their thousands through the winter, and the azurite miners below read the weather from when the flocks leave.

provinces.name: Xích Quả
provinces.lore: Inland forest on low hills. Its people gather hawthorn berries and make them into sweets and wine for Tống Khách market. Aspen woods grow on the slopes.

places.name: Chiến Diệp Lâm
places.look: White-barked aspens cover the low hills, their leaves shivering in the faintest wind and turning gold in autumn.
places.lore: Xích Quả's people cut aspen for firewood and for the light boxes they pack their berry sweets in. Hawthorn grows thick along its edges, and the village's pickers work the wood from first frost until the berries fall.

places.name: Xích Quả Thôn
places.look: Log houses on a hillside among hawthorn bushes red with berries.
places.lore: The villagers make hawthorn sweets and wine and sell them at Tống Khách market. Travellers carry them for the road.

provinces.name: Ôn Khê
provinces.lore: Forest and mountains with a volcanic heart, where a river reaches the sea. Its people farm along a brook warmed by the fire below and sell early vegetables to Liên Giang. Rock junipers grow on the mountain.

places.name: Nham Bách Lâm
places.look: Twisted junipers cling to the rocky slopes of the mountain.
places.lore: The juniper is burned as incense in Băng Tâm's halls. Its smoke is said to calm the mind.

places.name: Ôn Khê Thôn
places.look: Stone houses along a steaming brook, with green vegetable beds in the snow.
places.lore: The brook is warmed by the fire below the mountain. The villagers grow early vegetables and sell them in Liên Giang.

provinces.name: Hoàng Dương
provinces.lore: Steppe, forest, mountains and red badlands along a river between the frost coast and the desert. Its people herd and hunt gazelle. An Earth vein lies on the steppe.

places.name: Hồng Nê Mạch
places.look: A patch of red clay on the steppe, warm and soft underfoot.
places.lore: An Earth vein lies under the clay and keeps it from freezing hard. Hoàng Dương's people dig it for pots and for the red wash on their houses, and herders let their sheep lick it for salt.

places.name: Hoàng Dương Thôn
places.look: Felt tents and mud houses on a river bank in the steppe.
places.lore: The villagers herd sheep and hunt gazelle. They sell hides and meat to the frost coast.

provinces.name: Ngân Sương Nguyên
provinces.lore: Tundra rising to bare hills and small glaciers, white with frost most of the year. No one lives here. A Water spring that grows frost flowers draws Băng Tâm's ice cultivators.

places.name: Sương Hoa Tuyền
places.look: A spring in the tundra ringed with frost flowers that grow on the ice.
places.lore: A Water vein rises with the spring, and its cold grows feathery frost flowers on the ice each night. Băng Tâm's ice cultivators sit beside it, and a disciple who melts a flower with a careless breath must start the night again.

provinces.name: Phong Đao Lĩnh
provinces.lore: Bare hills and tundra on the north coast, where the wind cuts like a knife. Black jade is mined here in summer. No one lives here in winter.

places.name: Huyền Ngọc Khoáng
places.look: A small adit in the bare wind-cut hills, its spoil heaps glossy black and its hut roofs weighted with stones against the gale.
places.lore: Raven-black jade is cut here in the short summer and carried south on sledges before the snow. Băng Tâm's elders wear it as plain belt plaques, and the miners say the stone drinks the wind's cold.

places.name: Lang Nha Phong
places.look: A sharp peak of grey rock rising above the tundra like a fang.
places.lore: Its Metal qi gathers in the sharp rock. Snow wolves from Tuyết Lang Nguyên howl from its foot on winter nights, and the black jade miners leave the hills before the packs come down.

provinces.name: Đống Trạch Hoang
provinces.lore: Tundra and frozen marsh with patches of forest on the north coast. No one lives here; yaks graze the plain in summer. Trappers cross it only when the marsh is frozen.

places.name: Mao Ngưu Nguyên
places.look: Flat tundra trampled by herds of shaggy yaks.
places.lore: Wild spirit yaks graze here in summer, led by a huge black bull. Trappers keep their distance.

provinces.name: Hào Phong Lĩnh
provinces.lore: Bare hills and tundra around Tuyết Lang Nguyên, the snow wolves' plain. No one lives here. A Hàn Giang fort broken in the War of the Frost Coast stands on the coast.

places.name: Tuyết Lang Nguyên
places.look: Open tundra on a low rise, flat and white under a wide sky. Across it runs a low ridge of frost-split grey boulders, the dark mouths of wolf dens between them and trampled snow all around.

places.name: Cố Ngạn Bảo
places.look: A broken stone fort on the coast, its walls split and its gate fallen.
places.lore: Hàn Giang Môn built this fort around 400 to guard its coast. Băng Tâm stormed it in 497, the year before the Frost Coast fell.

provinces.name: Hàn Vụ Nguyên
provinces.lore: Tundra, forest and low hills often wrapped in cold fog from the sea. No one lives here. A mirror-clear Water vein lies on the plain.

places.name: Kính Băng Nhãn
places.look: A small round pool frozen as clear as a mirror in the tundra.
places.lore: A Water vein rises under the pool and keeps its ice as clear as glass. Băng Tâm disciples sit on it to meditate, as their elders did on Phiến Băng Hồ, and say they see their own faces looking back.

provinces.name: Bộ Điêu
provinces.lore: Forest and swamp on the north coast. Its people trap sable and fox and sell the fur in Mộc Lan. A marsh school's ruin lies on the coast.

places.name: Điêu Thử Lâm
places.look: A dense fir and swamp forest where the snow is stitched with the small paired tracks of sable.
places.lore: Bộ Điêu's trappers set their lines here, each family on its own marked trees. Sable are still plentiful, and the village keeps a rule to take none in spring so the wood is never trapped out.

places.name: Vụ Trạch Phái
places.look: Ruined stilt halls in a misty marsh on the coast.
places.lore: A small school founded in 560 to cultivate the marsh's Water qi. In 870 a cold fever came off the marsh and none of its forty disciples saw the spring.

places.name: Bộ Điêu Thôn
places.look: Log houses in the forest, with furs stretched on frames.
places.lore: The villagers trap sable and fox and sell the fur in Mộc Lan. Every trapper has his own line.

provinces.name: Kình Cốt
provinces.lore: Forest and swamp on the north-east coast. Its people hunt whales in summer with Trạc Anh's sea hunters and build with the bones. An abbey that joined Trạc Anh Đài lies empty on the marsh shore.

places.name: Đông Thanh Lâm
places.look: A forest of holly and fir, green and red in winter.
places.lore: Kình Cốt's people cut holly for the feast that ends the whaling season and hang it over the whalebone doorways. Thrushes and waxwings winter in the wood on its red berries.

places.name: Tê Nhạn Quán
places.look: An empty abbey on the marsh shore, geese roosting in its halls.
places.lore: A small abbey founded in 880. In 1095 its last abbot joined Trạc Anh Đài with his disciples, and the halls were left to the marsh.

places.name: Kình Cốt Thôn
places.look: Houses framed with whale ribs on the coast.
places.lore: The villagers hunt whales in summer with Trạc Anh's sea hunters. They build with the bones.
